title: Code throws exception only when executed using the xunit test runner

labels.name: Bug
labels.description: A fault in an existing feature

body:
If I create the following test (tested with xunit 1.9.2 and 2.0.0-beta5) I get an exception thrown on the second invocation of "Evidence" on the appdomain. However the same code runs fine in both a console application as well as a web-application, so my best guess is that it's related to how xunit works with AppDomains. 

I've been trying to find a work-around so I can at least continue using xunit for my unit tests but so far I haven't had any success.

``` csharp
    public class TestClass
    {
        static void Foo()
        {
        }

        [Fact]
        public void FooTest()
        {
            var ev = AppDomain.CurrentDomain.Evidence;
            CallContext.LogicalSetData("Test", (Action)Foo);
            ev = AppDomain.CurrentDomain.Evidence;
        }
    }
```
